title: EDG Community Update: Week of September 19th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**
- Richard Welsh [introduced Kabocha](https://forum.polkadot.network/t/introducing-kabocha-an-experimental-kusama-parachain-incubated-by-the-edgeware-community/327) and [(re)introduced Edgeware](https://forum.polkadot.network/t/re-introducing-edgeware-substrates-most-chaotic-governance-experiment-and-second-oldest-mainnet/500) on the new Polkadot Forum.
- [Introducing the Geo-awareness feature](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1572563883243577345) on JelliedOwl’s load-balanced RPC infrastructure!
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects can upgrade their nodes to the [pre-release v4.0.0](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v4.0.0) to be prepared in advance for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade’s on-chain democracy proposal.
- Upcoming Activities/Events: [Valorant Gaming Tournament](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6514-edggaming-tournament)

## **Ecosystem Updates**
- [Edgeware Docs](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1572584442056609793) now have been migrated to the new domain.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-sep-18/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb
